Getting Started
Customize Your Profile
Customize Your Profile

guns.lol allows you to fully customize your profile to make it unique and visually appealing. Here’s a breakdown of all the free customization options available.

Assets Uploader

You can upload custom assets to your profile, including:

Background Image & Video
Profile Avatar
Audios using the Audio Manager
Custom Cursor

For more information on how to upload assets, check out our guide below:

How To Upload Assets
General Customization

You can customize the following elements of your profile:

Description: Add a short bio or description.
Discord Presence: Show your Discord status on your profile.
Background Effects: Add background effects to your profile.
Username Effects: Add effects to your profile username.
Profile Opacity: Adjust the opacity of your profile box.
Profile Blur: Add a blur effect to your profile box.
Location: Add your location to your profile.
Glow Settings: Customize the glow effect on your profile.
Color Customization

Accent & Background Colors

Set a highlight color for accents.
Customize your background color.

Text & Icon Colors

Adjust text color to match your theme.
Change icon colors to your liking.

You can also enable Profile Gradient to add a gradient effect to your profile box.

Other Customization

You can also change the following preferences:

Monochrome Icons: Display every icon in a single color.
Animated Title: Animate the title of your profile page.
Swap Box Colors: Sets the accent color as the widget background instead of the text color.
Volume Control: Display a volume control button.
Use Discord Avatar: Use your Discord avatar as your profile picture.
Discord Avatar Decoration: Display your Discord avatar decoration.

Don’t forget to click Save Changes after customizing your profile!
